evidence.description: A flagship community by Emaar, designed to be the new Downtown. Dubai Creek Harboor offers everything within the area. The majority of this master community is still under development but will be a destination once the mall and other tourist attractions are completed. Amazing community young couple with kids. Offers the best of both worlds in terms of entertainment and dining experiences on its marina and promenade from one side, and plenty of kids play areas, parks and activities from the other side. Can get a bit crowded around 6pm when people are coming back from work as there are only 2 entrances at the moment but Emaar’s masterplan is showing a new road that is yet to be developed, as well as 3 metro stations that are currently being built #### Properties to explore [...] We visit Dubai Creek occasionally to see friend and it always leaves a strong impression. At first glance, it feels like a modern equivalent to Dubai Marina. This makes sense given they are both Emaar flagships. However, we feel the Creek significantly more spacious and less congested. We love taking a stroll at the waterfront promenade. On a clear sunny day, you will be treated to a stunning Burj Khalifa view from several vantage points. [...] Its proximity to Downtown, DIFC and DXB makes it incredibly strategic for now. As the city's master plan shifts the aviation hub further south, the Creek might lose some of its airport proximity advantage. As the saying goes - "Old is gold", Dubai Marina remains the more popular counterpart for tourists. Rarely, I hear tourists visiting Dubai Creek but Dubai Marina is always almost mentioned. Despite this, Dubai Creek is definitely the more relaxed, modern contender.
